designationHistory.indexText: Texas Point National Wildlife Refuge, near Sabine Pass on the upper Texas coast, was established in 1979.
designationHistory.note: Only the FWS brochure gives a year ("Established in 1980 and 1979, McFaddin NWR and Texas Point NWR"). No establishing document, authority or exact date was found, and no independent record.

sources.name: FWS, McFaddin and Texas Point NWRs brochure
